key_idea: Match each color in the square with a shape of the same size.
steps: The pink part is a 2 by 2 square, like shape A.
The yellow part is 2 wide and 3 tall, like shape B.
The green part is 2 squares side by side, like shape D. The blue part is 4 squares in a row, like shape C.
Shapes A, B, C and D fill the whole square, so shape E was not used.

choice_feedback.A: Shape A is used. It is the pink 2 by 2 square.
choice_feedback.B: Shape B is used. It is the yellow part, 2 wide and 3 tall.
choice_feedback.C: Shape C is used. It is the blue row of 4 at the bottom.
choice_feedback.D: Shape D is used. It is the green part with 2 squares.
